category_title: Individuals with SIB who engage in self-restraint to avoid aversive consequences
minimal_context: The student is sitting in a padded treatment room with a therapist and has continuous access to a preferred item during a control condition.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Here is your preferred item. You can play with it while we sit in the room.

STUDENT: (Ignores the item and crosses her hands tightly across her chest.)

TUTOR: You can use your hands to play if you want to.

STUDENT: (Uncrosses her hands and begins scratching and pinching her arms, then quickly places her hands behind her back.)

TUTOR: Let's just sit quietly then.

STUDENT: (Begins hitting herself in the head and banging her helmet against the padded wall, then immediately sits on her hands and holds them under her clothing to restrain them.)

options.A: Implement a specific termination stage counting down the final 3-5 sessions of treatment.
options.B: Provide follow-in talk that is related to the student's ongoing actions and attention.
options.C: Provide individual storage space for the preferred items in the padded treatment room.
options.D: Implement noncontingent reinforcement informed by competing stimulus assessments during the treatment sessions.
